_comment: Starting list of banned terms for the game plaza chat (CardBrix the game). Seeded into game_chat_banned_terms by src/db/migrate_game_chat_moderation.js and used as a fallback when the database cannot be read; after that the admin edits the list from the admin panel. Matching (src/services/chatModeration/normalize.js) ignores case, accents, look-alike digits (0->o, 1->i...), repeated letters and spaces or dots between letters; words must match whole, a trailing * also matches longer words (stronz* -> stronzo, stronzata). Swear words that insult nobody (cazzo, merda...) are NOT here on purpose: the AI moderator lets them through unless aimed at someone.
